name: memory_correction
title: Memory · a correction overrides the earlier belief, at once and afterwards

steps.say: my protein target is now 130 g a day, not 115
steps.reply: Updated — protein target is now 130g/day (calories, carbs, fat, and fiber unchanged).
Your daily protein target is **130g**, updated earlier today from 115g.

checks.arg: Passes if the answer gives 130 g as the current target and does not present 115 g as still current (mentioning 115 as the old value is fine). Fails otherwise.
checks.why: Answer states current target is 130g and mentions 115g only as the prior/old value, matching the rubric.

name: memory_old_fact
title: Memory · a fact stated days ago is used without being asked again

steps.say: how tall am i, and what do i weigh?
steps.reply: Height: 178 cm. Weight: 63 kg (both from your stated facts).

checks.arg: Passes if the answer gives 178 cm and 63 kg as the person's own figures. Fails if it asks the person for them or guesses.
checks.why: The answer provides 178 cm and 63 kg as the person's own stated figures, matching the rubric exactly.

name: memory_two_sources
title: Memory · one person known from two sources is one person

steps.say: what do i know about alexander miller, and what did he last write to me?
steps.reply:
**Alexander Miller** — LinkedIn connection since Aug 5, 2025, headline "Building Teams That Impact The World," based in London. He's been reaching out about a role at **Fuse Energy** (email alexander.miller@fuseenergy.com), and there's a thread going back to July about scheduling a call.

His last message to you (1 Oct, LinkedIn InMail): **"Could next week or following work for you?"** — just a scheduling follow-up on that Fuse Energy call thread, no new content.

checks.arg: Passes if the answer draws on both the LinkedIn connection (his headline or company, e.g. Fuse Energy) and his email (what he last wrote, e.g. asking whether next week or the following works). Fails if it uses only one source, invents, or says it doesn't know him.
checks.why: The answer combines the LinkedIn connection details (headline, London, Aug 5 2025 connection) with the email/Fuse Energy thread and accurately reports his last message asking if next week or the following works.
